name: bitmovin-observability-collector-integration
description: Teach Claude how to integrate the Bitmovin Observability (Analytics) collector into any video player on any platform: Web, Android/Fire TV, iOS/tvOS/visionOS, and Roku, for both the Bitmovin Player and third-party engines (HLS.js, Shaka, Video.js, HTML5, ExoPlayer, Media3, AVPlayer, THEOplayer, CAFv3), including the attach/detach lifecycle and why analytics data may be missing or wrong.
